root_cause: Cost governance existed for named platforms but did not explicitly guarantee auto-enrollment and a universal default for every current/future connected app.
decision: Extend the existing ONE BRAIN resource authority instead of creating a parallel cost system.
prevention: all current and future chats/agents/workflows/connectors inherit central cost policy
unknown/new connectors use universal default until platform-specific policy exists
cheapest sufficient route must preserve quality reliability security evidence and outcome
usage waste may be optimized autonomously but paid plan/billing changes require human approval
material cost/resource outcomes write back to existing Brain resource intelligence and learning
